newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tchibo to raise German coffee prices February 27.
newsitem.headline: Tchibo to raise German coffee prices February 27.

text.p: German coffee roaster Tchibo Frisch-Roest-Kaffee GmbH said it would raise retail prices for some of its products by 0.50 marks per 0.5 kilos effective February 27.
A statement from the company detailed a February 7 statement that Tchibo was planning price rises along with most of its competitors to offset higher costs.
Tchibo said raw materials prices had risen by 30 to 45 percent and the dollar by eight percent versus the mark since December.
This made price hikes inevitable, especially since the varieties chosen by Tchibo for its expensive blends often exceeded futures exchange quotations.

The price increase will cover the Privatkaffee range of eight single origin and special blends as well as the two products Herzhaft Mild and Feine Milde, accounting for about 60 percent of the product range.
Traders said Tchibo's price rise compared with the one mark increase envisaged by other roasters from March 10. Tchibo would be the first firm to feel any negative consumer reaction, they added.
